gloss: receipt of payment; arrival of funds

definitions.gloss: receipt of payment; arrival of funds; money received
definitions.explanation: The arrival or receipt of money, typically via bank transfer. Used in banking, business, and online transactions to confirm that payment has been received in an account.

examples.japanese: {着金|ちゃっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{着金|ちゃっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}します→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧。
examples.english: We will ship the product as soon as we confirm receipt of payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着金|ちゃっきん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Remittances from overseas can take several days for the funds to arrive.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arrival) + {金|きん} (money). A practical term used frequently in business correspondence and online shopping. Commonly seen in email notifications from banks and payment services.

Can be used as a suru verb: {着金|ちゃっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (for funds to arrive).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着金|ちゃっきん}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation of payment received
- {着金|ちゃっきん}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: payment received notification
- {着金|ちゃっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: for payment to be delayed
- {着金|ちゃっきん}{日|び}: date of payment receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧: deposit, incoming payment — more general, covers any money coming in
- ⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧: remittance, wire transfer — the act of sending money
- ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧: bank transfer — the specific method of transfer
